result: FAIL: R1 exact-mode identity contract bypass

findings.title: Preserve special permission bits in exact file identities
findings.problem: identity() reports oct(info.st_mode & 0o777), discarding setuid, setgid and sticky bits. replace_exact therefore accepts a file with mode 0o4755 against expected 0o755. Its postcondition reports 0o755 even when the promoted inode still has mode 0o4755.
findings.evidence: The independent two-fixture control extracted only the frozen identity and replace_exact functions. A staged 0o4755 fixture was accepted and promoted with actual mode 0o4755; the helper reported 0o755. A destination preimage at 0o4755 was also accepted against expected 0o755. Both checks completed without assertion; no installed paths were modified.
findings.reproduction: mode-control.py and mode-control.json; actual Python exit 0 recorded in mode-execution.json.
findings.requested_fix: Use stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode), or explicitly reject special permission bits, and add source/destination setuid, setgid and sticky-bit rejection controls. The proposed protected() target-identity entry check should also prevent full-mode or hard-link drift from being hidden by the preserved legacy inventory masks.
findings.disposition: Parent accepted R1; correction has not been reviewed in this receipt.
